On the basis of the statements so recorded,
Judicial Magistrate First Class, Sangrur has submitted report dated 05.03.2026 to the effect that the compromise has been effected between the partie partiess voluntarily and without any coercion or undue influence.
4. Learned State counsel as well as counsel for respondent No Nos.2 to 4 have not disputed the factum of compromise between the parties.
5. In view of the above, no useful purpose would be served to continue with the proceedings before the trial Court in the instant FIR.

6. Following the principles laid down by the Full Bench judgment of this Court in Kulwinder Singh and others Versus State of Punjab and another 2007 (3) RCR (Criminal) 1052 and appr approved oved by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gian Singh Versus State of Punjab and others (2012) 10 SCC 303,, this petition is allowed and FIR No.37, dated 28.03.2024, under Sections 419, 420, 465, 467,
468, 471 and 120 120-B B IPC and Section 66D of the Information and Technology Act, 2000, at Police Station Sadar, Sangrur, District Sangrur, Punjab (Annexure P-1) P 1) and subsequent proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise dated 20.01.2026 (Annexure P-2) are quashed.
7. Pending miscellaneous application(s), iiff any, stand(s) disposed of, accordingly.
(RUPINDERJIT CHAHAL) 06.03.2026 JUDGE Gurpreet i) Whether speaking/reasoned?
